root_cause.text: The USB framework unanchors URBs before invoking their completion callbacks, so URBs resubmitted in `mcba_usb_read_bulk_callback` are no longer anchored to `priv->rx_submitted` and thus are not freed by `usb_kill_anchored_urbs()` during device close, causing a memory leak.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states: "the USB framework unanchors the URB before the complete function is called. This means that once an in-URB has been completed, it is no longer anchored and is ultimately not released in usb_kill_anchored_urbs()." The patch adds `usb_anchor_urb(urb, &priv->rx_submitted)` before resubmission to fix the leak.
